summary_en: 185,000 shares (2.25% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3. Correction to prior disclosure: percentage of shares outstanding restated from 2.14% to 2.25%.
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Correction to 'Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)'
translation_en_brief: AMIYA Corporation issued a correction notice on August 12, 2026 to its prior disclosure on treasury share acquisition and ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange purchases. The correction addresses an error in the stated percentage of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). The share acquisition remains fixed at an upper limit of 185,000 shares; however, the percentage of shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares) has been restated from 2.14% to 2.25%. The method of acquisition (ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading) and all other material terms remain unchanged from the original notice. No new or amended financial amounts or execution timeline are disclosed in this correction.
